title: Text Properties panel UI parity: expose Var, Render-as-HTML, and Line-type dropdown
description: Flash 8 text Properties-panel parity (see reference screenshot). These TextDisplayObject fields are fully supported in the model AND compiled to SWF, but the PropertiesPanel TextView (packages/authoring-ui/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx) does not expose them: (1) 'Var:' field -> as2VariableName (currently editable nowhere in UI despite import+compile support). (2) 'Render text as HTML' toggle (<> icon) -> html field. (3) Consolidate the separate multiline/wordWrap/password checkboxes into Flash's single 'Line type' dropdown: Single line | Multiline | Multiline no wrap | Password (Password only for Input text). Also show the Border toggle for Dynamic text (currently input-only). Pure UI wiring to existing model fields — no model/import/compile changes. Acceptance: each control round-trips through the model and the published SWF reflects it.
